description:
From the Seven Thunders to the symbolism of Revelation’s living creatures, this episode tackles some of Scripture’s deepest mysteries. Our panel explores difficult theological questions—including the hardening of Pharaoh’s heart, the meaning of the Three Angels’ Messages, the 144,000, forgiveness and rebaptism, the Holy Spirit, and whether Satan still needs God’s permission to bring suffering. Join us for a thoughtful, Bible-based conversation that brings clarity to challenging passages and strengthens faith.

Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 

1.   Has the message of the seven thunders in Revelation been revealed yet? 

2. If God never tempts anyone and sacrifice is not acceptable to Him, how should we understand Genesis 22:1 in light of James 1:13-16?  

3.  If a husband is unfaithful but his wife forgives him, should he still be rebaptized?  

4. Can you please explain the Three Angels' Messages? Some people are saying this is not true.

5. Could you please explain John 20:22-23? “If you forgive anyone’s sins, their sins are forgiven.”

6.  Did God harden Pharaoh's heart? 

7.  What was the purpose and symbolism of the four living creatures in Revelation 4:7, also mentioned in Ezekiel? 

8.  Are we going to have alone time with Jesus in Heaven? From what I read, 144,000 follow him wherever He goes. 

9. When God clothed Adam and Eve, did they repent of their wrongs? In scripture, Adam blames God, and then the blame game continues. Why did he & Eve then receive animal skin as coverings? Was the nakedness of Adam & Eve literal?

10. Is the 144,000 literal or symbolic? My husband disagrees with the concept of the 144,000 being saved and refuses to follow Seventh-day Adventist beliefs. He cannot believe that out of 7 billion people in the world, only that number will be saved. 

11. In the book of Job, Satan needed permission from God to cause Job bodily grief, emotional grief, and spiritual suffering. Does that rule still apply today for the humans who are going through those very things? Does Satan still need God’s permission to cause people suffering?

12. Are we given the Holy Spirit from birth, or do we have to ask for the Holy Spirit?
